additions.note: Apache-2.0 multimodal model with 26.4B total parameters and 3.4B active. Its looped transformer processes text and images and generates text.

Downloadable 770B multimodal flagship with 49B active text parameters and 1M context. Tencent published instruction-tuned, FP8 and base checkpoints under the Tencent Hy License after the hosted release.
Multimodal understanding family that accepts text, images, audio, and video and generates text. WeChat Vision released 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B checkpoints under Apache-2.0.
Live API rollout of the voice model introduced in ChatGPT in October. It improves multilingual pronunciation, accent consistency, and transcription.

Apache-2.0 reasoning model for text chat, instruction following, and tool use. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates about 1B parameters and supports roughly 32K context. Also available through OVHcloud AI Endpoints.

Hosted multimodal reasoning model with 1M context, optimized for fast completion of software engineering, knowledge work, and science tasks. Available on the Gemini API paid tier and in eligible Google products.

Interactive world model with real-time text-guided editing and native audio. Rolled out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers through Project Genie on November 18 and to Gemini API developers on November 19.
Multimodal reasoning model based on Qwen3.8-27B and post-trained with reinforcement learning. RadixArk released BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoints under Apache-2.0.
MIT-licensed 2.3B on-device text model with a 32K context window. Microsoft published the unquantized checkpoint on Hugging Face ahead of the Windows rollout.

Downloadable multimodal model with 12B active parameters and 1M context. Tencent released instruction-tuned, FP8 and base checkpoints under the Tencent Hy License after the November 16 hosted release.
35B mixture-of-experts coding and agent model with a 1M-token context window. Apache-2.0 weights are downloadable. The date marks the announcement, and the first download date is unverified.
Hosted model that generates video with synchronized audio from text or an image. Phancy offers an online trial and lists downloadable weights as forthcoming.
Legal research configuration of GPT-6.2 Astra with an expanded legal search index. ChatGPT Enterprise customers can request access through the Trusted Access Program, including API access.
Coding model for multi-file changes, repository-wide reasoning and debugging. Available to eligible GitHub Copilot subscribers at launch.

Smaller coding model for targeted edits, explanations and routine fixes. Available to eligible GitHub Copilot users, including Free and Student plans, and in limited preview through Microsoft Foundry.
Image generation and image editing model released in public preview through Microsoft Foundry, following the October image-editing preview.
Faster image generation and editing variant for high-volume workflows. Available in public preview through Microsoft Foundry and powers the MAI Canvas workspace.
Microsoft’s first low-latency live speech-to-speech model. A demo launched in MAI Labs, and Microsoft opened registration for interested customers.
Security model announced at Ignite. Microsoft scheduled the rollout to eligible customers in its security products for mid-December.
Multimodal decision model for structured tasks such as routing and classification. Generally available through Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter, and Vercel after an October public preview.

Updated 105B mixture-of-experts checkpoint with 10.3B active parameters and additional post-training for tool use, instruction following, and Indian languages. Sarvam published NVFP4 and BF16 builds under Apache-2.0.

exclusions.candidate: PixVerse V6-max, Kimi K3.1 Pro Prime, and Dragon Copilot Transcribe
exclusions.reason: PixVerse added V6-max to its own API October 22, before the November reseller listing. Kimi Prime is a faster serving mode of K3.1 Pro. Dragon Copilot Transcribe uses the already recorded MAI Transcribe 2.
